connections.notes: 4A (Great Bronze Doors) sits directly at the northern entrance to room 4 (Great Northern Hall). There is a clear doorway passage connecting them — the bronze doors themselves are the connection point between the corridor and the hall.
Room 9 (Northern Corridor) is directly west of 4A along the east-west passage. There is a clear open corridor connecting 9 to 4A with no walls blocking the passage.
Room 6 (Sealed Eastern Door) is directly east of 4A along the same east-west corridor. A clear open passage connects 4A eastward to 6.
Room 13 (The Riven Hall) is to the north of 4A. There appears to be an open passage or corridor leading northward from 4A into room 13.

not_connected.reason: Room 5 (Collapsed Burial Chamber) is separated from 4A by walls. No visible doorway or passage connects 4A directly to room 5.
Room 7 (Western Corridor) is further west beyond room 9. There is no direct passage from 4A to 7; room 9 lies between them.
8W (River Ledge) is to the east beyond room 6 and separated by walls. No direct passage from 4A to 8W is visible.
J3 (Trapped Fork) is located far to the west-southwest of 4A with multiple rooms and corridors between them. No direct connection exists.
R1 (North-West River Crossing) is far to the northwest. No river or passage directly connects 4A to R1.
R2 (North River Crossing) is to the north in the river area. No direct river crossing or passage connects 4A to R2.
R3 (North River Passage) is far to the northeast. No direct connection to 4A is visible.
R4 (East River Crossing) is to the east beyond walls and the river. No direct connection from 4A to R4.
R5 (River exit at cliff) is far to the south. No direct connection to 4A.
